provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled microscopy-axis summaries. Each vector is one equal-weight observed UNORIENTED filament axis: u and -u represent the same observation. Its printed length is arbitrary coordinate scaling,not filament length or weight. Normalize every vector to unit Euclidean length before forming Q=(1/N)*sum_i[(3/2)*u_i*u_i_transpose-(1/2)*I].
director: The scalar order requested is the largest ALGEBRAIC eigenvalue of Q. Its maximizing director axis is unique only when that largest eigenvalue is simple; opposite vector signs denote one axis,not measured head-tail polarity. Count multiplicity within1e-10. Largest absolute eigenvalue is a different criterion.
scope: Controlled filament orientation geometry,not a protein structure, measured biological polarity, dynamics, molecular reconstruction or a material phase assignment.
